description: Make the attached project live. Call it only after the user agreed to the attach_project summary. Adds the project's frontends, backends and hosted processes to the running agent (never saved to the agent's config; applying does not write the project file) and starts its auto-start processes. Fails, applying nothing, when a frontend hostname is already served by another project, a shared port or folder, or the agent's config; the error names the owner. Calling it again changes nothing.
name: apply_project
